title: OpsPilot runbook
description: A named sequence of REGISTRY tools with conditions (FR-24). Every step names a tool; write steps go through the same approval gate as a model proposal (SEC-O15). There is no free-form step type.

params.description: Runtime parameters the caller may supply (e.g. target, service); referenced as {{ params.x }}

tool.description: Registry tool name. Deny-listed names are invalid by schema as a first line; the loader also checks the live registry.

when.description: Condition over prior step results, e.g. health.status != 200 or mem.disk_pct > 85. Not SQL, not shell.

approval.description: Informational: write tools ALWAYS go through the gate; setting false on a write tool is rejected by the loader.
